title: Oscar and the Locker
author: Casper Amberdale
blurb: Xanthe Villalobos, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
